title: Fourier estimate failure probability
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $P\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a set of coordinates, let $z\colon P\to\{\pm1\}$ be a fixed assignment, let $k\ge0$, and let $\delta$ be a rational number with $0<\delta\le1/2$. Draw uniformly a batch of the prescribed size whose inputs assign signs to the coordinates outside $P$, and label each input by the restriction of $f$ with the coordinates in $P$ fixed according to $z$. The probability that at least one Fourier coefficient in the low-degree family on the remaining coordinates is estimated with error at least the prescribed accuracy is at most $\delta/4$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the sign cube
